The '''''Icebreaker''''' was a waterhunter manufactured by the [[BramDorc Corporation]]. By [[44 ABY]], it was one of the last BramDorc products still known to exist. By this [[Time/Legends|time]], it was exhibited in the [[New Brampis Starship Museum]].
